title: Mutual aid agreement to help Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell
summary: Eight council members, with one excused, backed a bill letting Maui County help the County of Kauaʻi respond to and recover from Hurricane Lowell. The agreement does not require Maui County to send staff or resources it does not have or needs. A council member said Maui wants to help because of the help Kauaʻi gave after the fire.

timeline.text: Eight members, with one excused, backed a bill to send help to Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell.
